artist.name: ANTHH
artist.bio: Some things are easier to play than explain.
artist.about: I play guitar, sing, write songs and keep collecting the little moments that turn into music.
artist.musicIntro: Originals, covers, demos and late-night ideas.
artist.guitarsIntro: Every instrument leaves a little of itself in the music.
artist.educationDetail: Student, building a creative life alongside technology.
artist.journey: I started singing before I ever imagined where music would take me. Later, I picked up a guitar and slowly discovered another way to express the things I couldn’t always put into words. For a long time, though, I wasn’t completely serious about music. I was afraid that it might not work out, and that fear made me hold myself back. Eventually, I realized that I didn’t want to spend my life wondering what could have happened. I decided that I would simply do what makes me happy, whether it works out exactly the way I hope or not. So I keep singing, playing guitar, writing songs, recording, and learning along the way. I’m interested in the space where technology and music meet, and I want to keep turning the ideas in my head into something people can actually feel. I don’t know exactly where this path will take me, and maybe everything won’t work out the way I imagine — but I’ve stopped letting that be the reason I don’t try. For now, I just want to keep creating, keep getting better, and see how far I can take it.
artist.future: My goal is to grow into a professional recording artist and songwriter, work with serious musicians and producers I respect, release original music, and build a body of work that feels genuinely mine.
artist.producerPitch: If you are a producer, artist, composer, studio or creative team looking for a guitarist, vocalist, songwriter or a hungry collaborator, I am open to conversations, sessions and collaborations.
artist.skills: Guitar · Vocals · Songwriting · Recording · Creative Direction
